notes: «قال ابن رافع حدثنا وقال، إسحاق أخبرنا» gives two co-transmitters at one level (rule 2). The text is garbled where «أن» meets «الله عليه وسلم»; the saying is Ibn Umar's account.

fixes.reason: The stored text joins «أن» and «الله» with the words between them missing, so the saying's opening cannot be read.
